notes.title: Demo Update v0.3
notes.content:
[p][i][b]Demo v0.3 Patch Notes[/b][/i][/p][p]
[b]New Features[/b]  
- New Drive stage! 
- New enemies! 
- More mods and exes! 
- New music and audio! 
- Database feature for collection purposes 
- New jumping mini game event 
- Drawing Tablet support (Leave your sensitivity to default) 
- AFK screensaver 
- Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese localization has been added[/p][p][/p][p][b]Improvements/Changes[/b] 
- Keyboard input for alternative input (X for LMB, Z for RMB)
- EXEs now run on limited charges instead of a battle cooldown system
- You can now hold to autoclick for Clicking Cursor
- Tutorial has been reworked
- Hint tooltip added
- Rarity glow has been added to drops
- Buffed draw lengths for drawing cursors
- Better clarity on the side nav bar
- Better clarity on the Spore Virus
- Economy crash, coin pickups have been reduced for better balancing
- Boss 1 HP has been slightly buffed
- Balanced droprates
- Endscreens visual update[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update v0.2
notes.content:
[p][b][i]Demo v0.2 Patch Notes[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features[/b] 
- Health Bars have been added to viruses for better combat awareness 
- Difficulty option is available in the cursor select window (End screen displays difficulty beside Drive) 
- 4 additional MOD files and 1 consumable have been added 
- New cursor unlocked as an accessibility feature 
- Placeholder Simplified Chinese and Japanese localization has been added[/p][p][/p][p][b]Improvements/Changes[/b] 
- Viruses health has been slightly nerfed 
- UI interactions now provide more visual feedback 
- The Trap Room (Yellow turrets) has been temporarily disabled due to frustration among new players 
- The Tutorial window on first launch has been renamed to "Instruction Video" for clarity 
- Loot is now sorted by rarity tier, making it easier to identify valuable drops 
- The Initiator is now unlocked as the first combo instead of the second 
- The Mimic Room no longer has a 100% spawn rate 
- Higher loot rates have been applied to Tier 3 Virus Attack folders[/p][p][/p][p][b]Audio & Visual Updates[/b] 
- First Bug Theme has been updated 
- Virus Attack Combat Theme has been updated[/p][p][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b] 
- Kamikaze Drones now despawn automatically after enemy waves are cleared 
- The Sacrifice Room will no longer allow sacrificing the last remaining health (0 hearts) 
- Boss screenshake no longer lingers after returning to the main menu 
- Cursor position now properly aligns with the system cursor after tabbing out and back in 
- Volume settings now load correctly when the game starts up 
- Fixed volume settings not persisting on boot[/p]

notes.title: Identifile Demo is now available!
notes.content:
We're super excited to announce that the free demo for Identifile is now available! Get ready to fight for your computer's survival in this fast-paced blend of bullet hell and exploration!

[b]Access the demo here:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3263870?snr=5000_5100__

[b]Watch the trailer:[/b]

[previewyoutube=0MQtwSgG_pE;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Please be aware that the game is in the early stages of development. The gameplay may not be final. Bugs may also be present. For now, progress is only saved locally, cloud save is in the works![/i]

We look forward to hearing your feedback in our discord channel!

- Gearbyte Games
